title: Cuproptosis-Related Genes as Prognostic Biomarkers for Sepsis: Insights into Immune Function and Personalized Immunotherapy.

models.verbatim_formula: CuRGs risk score = LIAS x (-2.64) + PDHA1 x (-3.10) + PDHB x (-2.82)
models.expression_scale_used: GSE65682 expression after sva normalization (scale not stated)
models.cutoff: median CuRGs score (Results); Methods say optimal survival cutoff
models.reported_performance: Whole GSE65682 (n=479) tdAUC 0.733/0.652/0.662 at 7/14/28 d; random 1:1 split training (n=240) 0.731/0.662/0.694; validation (n=239) 0.732/0.641/0.628; multivariate Cox HR 1.393
models.source_location: Methods 'Construction of CuRGs Risk Model' (formula) + Results Figures 2-3

models.outcome_definition: Consensus clusters A/B/C (k=3) compared for 28-day survival; B best
models.reported_performance: KM 28-day survival difference across clusters in GSE65682 (Figure 5B); no AUC

notes: INTERNAL CONTRADICTION: formula gives PDHA1 a negative coefficient (-3.10), but text says multivariate Cox showed PDHA1 is a risk factor and PDHA1 is higher in the high-score group; with all-negative coefficients the stated directions cannot all hold. Coefficients recorded exactly as printed; PDHA1 direction recorded as 'risk' per text; sign of PDHA1 coefficient is suspect. Model fit on all 479 GSE65682 patients, then split 1:1 only for evaluation (not true held-out). Clustering methods mention 'DE-CuRGs' but Results say clustering used the 3 key genes. Text also writes 'GSE65862' and 'PDHH1' (typos).
